summary: Keep self-throttled agent seats out of host admission pressure

rules.detail: The default host PSI brake excludes app-agent-seats.slice through its configured exclusion list. ARC credit uses the same protected cgroups, job-parent exclusions and additional exclusions instead of raw host memory PSI. Memory full avg60 at or above one percent, missing observations, or MemAvailable below the configured floor withhold ARC credit.

compatibility.detail: Explicit exclusion lists still replace the defaults and must include any self-throttled seat subtrees. Non-seat protected pressure and the host MemAvailable floor continue to close admission. Explicit seat-local observation remains possible with a policy protecting that seat without excluding it.

downtime.detail: No migration; restart the daemon to apply the updated defaults.

manual.detail: No new configuration fields or commands.

recovery.detail: Binary rollback requires no data migration.
